title: Ugly color pink.
text: Ugly color pink.. I am a little bummed out about the color of this. It's almost brown in color. It's so pale and dismal. I put a shell-pink pillow next to it so you can see the difference. It's a nice big size, the stitching is perfect and the welds look ok. Just wish the pink was pretty.
